fields.description: Binghatti Luxuria combines studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments in Jumeirah Village Triangle. A retail base and shared leisure spaces support the residential tower, while selected two-bedroom drawings include a private lap pool. That feature belongs to the illustrated type and should not be assumed for every apartment.

overview: The brochure counts 457 homes and 12 retail shops. The separate facts pack repeats the category counts but incorrectly prints 213 as its residential total; the brochure total agrees with the category sum.
The building description separates 24 residential floors from basements, podium, ground, mechanical and roof levels. Do not interpret a portal’s total-storey figure as 24 apartments floors only.
research.locationNote: Jumeirah Village Triangle, Dubai, with developer-described connections to E311 and Al Khail Road. Confirm the exact approach, orientation and outlook of the selected home.
research.priceNote: The own page displays AED 766999. This is a marketing starting guide, not a verified currently available unit, signed offer or Aliyas allocation.
research.paymentNote: The own FAQ publishes 20% deposit,50%during construction and 30%on completion. No dated payment sheet was linked in the retrieved brochure/facts set. Confirm instalment amounts and dates in the selected-home agreement.
research.handoverNote: Binghatti’s own page estimates Q3 2027. No retrieved primary completion certificate or current dated construction report establishes delivery. Confirm the contracted date and any revision directly.
